## 1. End-to-End Workflow Flowchart

The complete RFP response process from document upload to publication:

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A["📥 RFP Document Upload"] --> B["⚙️ PreProcess Hook<br/>Extract requirements<br/>Parse sections"]
    B --> C["🔀 PHASE 1: ANALYSIS<br/>Parallel Execution"]

    C --> C1["⚖️ Legal-Analyzer<br/>Contract review<br/>Risk assessment<br/>~15 min"]
    C --> C2["🏗️ Tech-Analyzer<br/>Requirements mapping<br/>Feasibility analysis<br/>~20 min"]
    C --> C3["💰 Finance-Analyzer<br/>Budget calculation<br/>Pricing strategy<br/>~10 min"]

    C1 --> D{"✅ Validation Hook<br/>All sections<br/>complete?"}
    C2 --> D
    C3 --> D

    D -->|❌ Missing| D1["🔄 Retry Failed<br/>Agents"]
    D1 --> C

    D -->|✅ Complete| E["📝 PHASE 2: WRITING<br/>Sequential Execution"]

    E --> E1["✍️ Content-Writer<br/>Proposal sections<br/>Corporate voice<br/>~40 min"]
    E1 --> E2["💵 Pricing-Calculator<br/>Pricing tables<br/>Payment schedule<br/>~15 min"]
    E2 --> E3["📋 Compliance-Checker<br/>Regulatory review<br/>Certifications<br/>~10 min"]

    E3 --> F["🎨 Format Hook<br/>Apply template<br/>Generate TOC<br/>Export PDF"]

    F --> G["📖 PHASE 3: REVIEW<br/>Sequential Gating"]

    G --> G1["🔍 QA-Reviewer<br/>Grammar, coherence<br/>Cross-references<br/>~20 min"]
    G1 --> G2["⚖️ Legal-Reviewer<br/>Contract terms<br/>Liability clauses<br/>~30 min"]
    G2 --> G3["👔 Exec-Approver<br/>Strategic alignment<br/>Business case<br/>~10 min"]

    G3 --> H{"👤 Human-in-Loop<br/>Executive Review<br/>C-Level Approval"}

    H -->|❌ Rejected| H1["❌ STOP<br/>Log reason"]
    H -->|🔄 Feedback| H2["📝 Revise Writing<br/>Apply comments"]
    H2 --> E

    H -->|✅ Approved| I["🚀 PHASE 4: PUBLISH"]

    I --> I1["📄 Export PDF"]
    I1 --> I2["📧 Email to Client"]
    I2 --> I3["🗂️ Archive Artifacts"]
    I3 --> I4["📊 Update CRM"]

    I4 --> J["✨ COMPLETE<br/>RFP Response Submitted"]

    style A fill:#e1f5ff
    style J fill:#c8e6c9
    style H fill:#fff9c4
    style D fill:#ffe0b2
    style F fill:#ffe0b2
    style H1 fill:#ffcdd2
```

## 2. Timeline & Gantt Chart

Showing how parallel and sequential phases compose the workflow:

```{mermaid}
gantt
    title RFP Response Workflow Timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat %H:%M

    section Phase 1: Analysis
    Legal-Analyzer           :c1, 2025-01-15 10:00, 15m
    Tech-Analyzer            :c2, 2025-01-15 10:00, 20m
    Finance-Analyzer         :c3, 2025-01-15 10:00, 10m
    Validation Hook          :crit, c4, after c2, 2m

    section Phase 2: Writing
    Content-Writer           :active, e1, after c4, 40m
    Pricing-Calculator       :e2, after e1, 15m
    Compliance-Checker       :e3, after e2, 10m
    Format Hook              :crit, e4, after e3, 5m

    section Phase 3: Review
    QA-Reviewer              :r1, after e4, 20m
    Legal-Reviewer           :r2, after r1, 30m
    Exec-Approver            :r3, after r2, 10m
    Human-in-Loop            :crit, r4, after r3, 30m

    section Phase 4: Publish
    Export & Email           :p1, after r4, 10m
    Archive & CRM            :p2, after p1, 5m

    section Timeline
    T+0 (Start)              :dos, 2025-01-15 10:00, 1m
    T+25 (Analysis Done)     :dos, 2025-01-15 10:25, 1m
    T+30 (Writing Start)     :dos, 2025-01-15 10:30, 1m
    T+95 (Review Start)      :dos, 2025-01-15 11:35, 1m
    T+160 (Human Decision)   :dos, 2025-01-15 12:40, 1m
    T+180 (Publish)          :dos, 2025-01-15 13:00, 1m
```

**Key Observations:**
- Analysis parallelization saves ~35 minutes
- Writing phase is sequential (dependencies)
- Review gates catch issues early
- Human approval adds 30 minutes
- Total: 3.5 hours vs 2-4 weeks baseline

## 3. Sequence Diagram - Agent Interactions

How the command orchestrator coordinates with agents and MCPs:

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CMD as RFP<br/>Orchestrator
    participant LA as Legal<br/>Analyzer
    participant TA as Tech<br/>Analyzer
    participant FA as Finance<br/>Analyzer
    participant DB as MCP:<br/>Contracts DB
    participant ERP as MCP:<br/>ERP System

    User->>CMD: Upload RFP Document
    CMD->>CMD: Parse & Extract Requirements

    par Parallel Execution
        CMD->>LA: Analyze contract terms
        LA->>DB: Query similar past RFPs
        DB-->>LA: Return 5 precedent contracts
        LA-->>CMD: legal-analysis.md
    and
        CMD->>TA: Assess technical feasibility
        TA->>TA: Map requirements
        TA-->>CMD: tech-analysis.md
    and
        CMD->>FA: Calculate pricing
        FA->>ERP: Fetch cost data
        ERP-->>FA: Return hourly rates, overhead
        FA-->>CMD: finance-analysis.md
    end

    CMD->>CMD: Validation Hook: Check completeness
    CMD->>CMD: Launch Writing Phase

    Note over CMD,FA: Sequential Phase 2
    CMD->>CMD: Content-Writer generates draft
    CMD->>CMD: Pricing-Calculator uses finance data
    CMD->>CMD: Compliance-Checker verifies

    CMD->>CMD: Format Normalization Hook
    CMD->>CMD: Apply template, generate PDF

    CMD->>CMD: Launch Review Phase
    CMD->>CMD: QA → Legal → Executive review

    CMD->>User: Human-in-Loop: Request approval
    User->>CMD: APPROVED

    CMD->>User: Email with proposal PDF
```

## 4. State Diagram - RFP Document States

Document transitions through workflow phases:

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Uploaded

    Uploaded --> Parsing: Parse RFP
    Parsing --> Analysis: Extract complete

    Analysis --> AnalysisInProgress: Legal starts
    Analysis --> AnalysisInProgress: Tech starts
    Analysis --> AnalysisInProgress: Finance starts

    AnalysisInProgress --> AnalysisValidation: All agents done

    AnalysisValidation --> Writing: ✅ Complete
    AnalysisValidation --> AnalysisRetry: ❌ Missing sections
    AnalysisRetry --> AnalysisInProgress

    Writing --> WritingInProgress: Content starts
    WritingInProgress --> PricingPhase: Content done

    PricingPhase --> CompliancePhase: Pricing done
    CompliancePhase --> FormattingPhase: Compliance done

    FormattingPhase --> Review: PDF formatted

    Review --> ReviewInProgress: QA starts
    ReviewInProgress --> LegalReviewPhase: QA complete
    LegalReviewPhase --> ExecReviewPhase: Legal complete

    ExecReviewPhase --> HumanApproval: Reviews complete

    HumanApproval --> Approved: ✅ Approved
    HumanApproval --> Feedback: 🔄 Feedback
    HumanApproval --> Rejected: ❌ Rejected

    Feedback --> WritingInProgress: Re-enter Writing

    Approved --> Published: Export & Email
    Published --> Archived: Archive artifacts
    Archived --> [*]

    Rejected --> [*]

    note right of Analysis
        Parallel execution
        of 3 agents
    end note

    note right of Writing
        Sequential execution
        with dependencies
    end note

    note right of HumanApproval
        Executive sign-off
        on $450k decision
    end note
```

## 6. Parallel Content Generation - Timeline View

Detailed timeline showing how parallelization saves time:

```{mermaid}
timeline
    title Parallel vs Sequential Analysis Phase

    section Sequential (125 min)
        Legal-Analyzer: 15 min
        Tech-Analyzer: 20 min
        Finance-Analyzer: 10 min
        (Total: 45 min sequential)

    section Parallel (20 min) [OPTIMIZED]
        All 3 agents: 20 min (max of 15, 20, 10)
        Time saved: 25 min (56% reduction)

    section Why Parallel Works
        No dependencies: Legal, Tech, Finance independent
        Same data source: RFP document available to all
        Independent outputs: Each agent creates separate analysis
        Validation ensures completeness: Hook checks all 3
```

## 7. Decision Tree - Workflow Branching

How decisions affect workflow path:

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    A["📥 RFP Upload"] --> B["PHASE 1: ANALYSIS"]
    B --> C{"Completeness<br/>Check?"}

    C -->|❌| C1["Re-run Failed<br/>Agents"]
    C1 --> B

    C -->|✅| D["PHASE 2: WRITING"]
    D --> E{"Format<br/>Validation?"}

    E -->|❌| E1["Re-apply<br/>Template"]
    E1 --> E

    E -->|✅| F["PHASE 3: REVIEW"]
    F --> G["QA + Legal + Exec<br/>Reviews"]

    G --> H{"Executive<br/>Decision?"}

    H -->|✅ APPROVED| I["PHASE 4: PUBLISH"]
    H -->|❌ REJECTED| J["📛 STOP<br/>Log reason"]
    H -->|🔄 FEEDBACK| K["Revise & Rewrite"]

    K --> D

    I --> L["✨ RFP SUBMITTED<br/>to Client"]

    style H fill:#fff9c4,stroke:#f57f17,stroke-width:3px
    style I fill:#c8e6c9
    style J fill:#ffcdd2

    classDef decision fill:#e1f5fe,stroke:#01579b,stroke-width:2px
    class C,E,H decision
```

## 8. Error Handling & Retry Strategy

How the workflow handles failures:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Task Execution"] --> B{"Success?"}

    B -->|✅ Yes| C["Continue to<br/>Next Phase"]

    B -->|❌ No| D["Log Error"]
    D --> E{"Retry<br/>Eligible?"}

    E -->|No| E1["🚨 Escalate to<br/>Human Review"]
    E1 --> F["Stop & Alert"]

    E -->|Yes| E2["Increment<br/>Retry Count"]
    E2 --> E3{"Max Retries<br/>Exceeded?"}

    E3 -->|Yes| F
    E3 -->|No| G["Wait & Retry"]
    G --> A

    style F fill:#ffcdd2
    style C fill:#c8e6c9
```
